title: National Sales Account Manager
description:
Lasko Products, a market leader in home comfort products for over 100 years, is looking to add a National Account Manager to drive revenue growth and strengthen partnerships. 

This role is responsible for developing and executing strategic account plans aligned with Lasko’s seasonal business model, product innovation roadmap, and omnichannel growth strategy. The National Account Manager will own customer relationships, lead joint business planning, manage forecasting and promotional execution, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver profitable growth across both in-store and digital platforms.

The ideal candidate brings strong experience managing multiple accounts, analytical rigor, and the ability to balance strategic planning with operational excellence in a fast-paced, weather-driven category.

Key Responsibilities
Account Strategy & Growth
• Develop and execute annual joint business plans across numerous channels aligned with company revenue and profitability targets.
• Drive assortment expansion, promotional strategy, and distribution growth across fans, heaters, air purifiers, and related home comfort categories.
• Identify whitespace opportunities and seasonal growth initiatives
• Lead line reviews, category reviews, and new item presentations.
• Monitor competitive activity and recommend pricing, assortment, and promotional adjustments to maintain category leadership.

Customer Relationship Management
• Serve as the primary point of contact for distributors, professional channel partners, and key accounts (e.g., distributors, co-ops, and independent retailers).
• Build strong, collaborative partnerships to support long-term growth and brand expansion.
• Partner closely with customer merchandising and digital teams to support omnichannel growth, including owned.com and marketplace strategies where applicable.
• Represent Lasko’s brand positioning and innovation roadmap in customer meetings and industry events.

Forecasting & Seasonal Execution
• Own account-level forecast inputs in partnership with Sales Operations and Demand Planning.
• Ensure alignment between promotional calendars, seasonal inventory builds, and supply chain readiness.
• Monitor POS, inventory, and sell-through trends to proactively manage in-stock performance.
• Collaborate within the SIOP framework to support weather-driven demand fluctuations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Partner with Product Development and Marketing to align new product introductions with customer needs and use cases.
• Collaborate with Finance to manage pricing strategy, margin targets, and trade investment.
• Work closely with Operations and Logistics to ensure strong OTIF performance and customer satisfaction.
• Coordinate digital content, packaging, and merchandising support to ensure brand consistency.

Performance & Reporting
• Analyze sales performance, promotional ROI, category trends, and distribution metrics.
• Develop customer-ready presentations and internal executive updates.
• Track and deliver against KPIs including revenue, margin, inventory turns, in-stock %, and share growth.

Qualifications
• 5–10 years of experience in National Account Management or Sales within consumer durables or CPG.
• Proven success in seasonal planning and managing weather-sensitive categories.
• Strong understanding of joint business planning, trade spend management, and P&L ownership.
• Analytical mindset with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; familiarity with distributor data, POS reporting, and BI tools preferred.
• Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field required.
• Travel as needed to support customer meetings, distributor visits, and industry events.

About Lasko Products

Love Your Air

Lasko Products is the leading air solutions brand with a reputation for reliable products, peak performance, and perpetual innovation – our commitment to our customers for over a century. Founded in 1906 by Henry Lasko in Philadelphia, Lasko has evolved for over a century to become the global leader in air solution products. From our roots in small appliances, fans, and portable heaters, we’ve grown to become the leading home comfort company while maintaining our unwavering commitment to quality and value. Today, Lasko stands as a symbol of innovation, offering consumers around the world high-performance products; portable fans, heaters, air purifiers, humidifiers, and home ventilation solutions. Our well-known brands, Lasko, B-Air, BlueDri, Air King, and Guardian Technologies, serve both consumer and commercial markets across North America and internationally. As an American company for 120 years, we take pride in upholding the spirit of hard work, trust and accessibility, ensuring that Lasko remains available to all, for generations to come. Headquartered in West Chester, Pennsylvania, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in Tennessee and Texas, Lasko intends to set the standard in the air solutions category for another 100 years.  

Lasko’s mission is to provide comfort you can trust.

Our company’s success is based on our culture of GRACE, with five core “Be” values outlining how we live it.

Growth Mindset — Be Bold 

• We are never the finished product ─ every failure is a data point, every setback is a setup.

 Recognition — Be Together 

• We win together. We celebrate together! High performance deserves to be seen ─ named, specific, remembered.

 Authenticity — Be Real 

• No masks. No politics. Show up as you are, say what you mean, and mean what you say.

Clear Communication — Be Clear   

• Say it plainly. Say it once. Say it to the right person. Clarity is kindness.

Extreme Ownership — Be Accountable  

• No blame. No excuses. Own the win and the loss. No exceptions.

Why Join Lasko?  

At Lasko, we believe people do their best work when they’re supported ─ personally and professionally. That’s why we offer flexible hours and a hybrid work schedule for our corporate team, promoting employees to balance life and work in a way that fits their lifestyle. Our dog-friendly corporate headquarters adds a fun, welcoming atmosphere, while our competitive salaries with bonus potential recognize and reward your contributions. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes a strong 401(k) match, wellness incentives, and robust health coverage. Join Lasko and be part of a legacy of innovation – at a company that values flexibility, growth, and a culture where you can thrive.

title: Account Executive
description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

About College Pads 

College Pads is transforming the way students navigate the transition from on-campus to off-campus life. Our platform enables universities to support their students by streamlining the process of finding and securing off-campus housing. By working closely with higher education institutions, we offer a trusted tool for students to connect with property managers and rental listings, helping to foster a foundation for wellbeing and success. As of January 2025, College Pads is part of StarRez.  

The Role  

We are seeking a results-driven Regional Account Executive to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you’ll build strong relationships with landlords, property managers, and real estate professionals. You will be responsible for expanding our regional presence, prospecting new clients, closing deals, and managing ongoing client relationships. As a Regional Account Executive, you will collaborate closely with marketing, client success, and customer service teams to drive strategic growth and long-term client retention. 

Role Specifics  

• Work Location: Remote, US

• Travel: 25% (The percentage of travel is an estimation, and it could vary up or down based on business needs throughout the year.) 

• Compensation Structure: In addition to the base salary listed below, this role is eligible for a bonus/commission plan. When meeting 100% of goals, the expected total annual compensation for this role is $170,000.

• Reporting Structure: This role reports to the Sales Manager. 

Application Deadline: This role will accept applications on a rolling basis until filled. 

What You Will Own  

• Identifying, prospecting, and securing new partnerships with landlords and property managers within your assigned region 

• Delivering tailored sales presentations, effectively communicating the benefits of our platform, and negotiating contracts to close new business 

• Building and maintaining strong, long-lasting relationships with existing clients, ensuring their satisfaction and maximizing opportunities for upsell and retention 

• Working closely with Marketing, Client Success, and Customer Service to develop strategies that attract new clients and retain existing ones 

• Sharing feedback on regional trends to enhance product offerings and client engagement 

• Meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales targets by consistently pursuing and closing high-quality deals 

• Staying informed about industry trends, competitor activity, and local housing markets to position College Pads in your markets effectively 

Required Qualifications  

• 4+ years of experience in sales, account management, or business development,  

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence decision-makers 

• Solid negotiation skills and the ability to navigate complex contracts and deal structures 

• Comfortable working remotely and independently, with strong time management and organizational skills 

• A demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets 

• Proficiency in CRM software (e.g. Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and MS Office or Google Workspace tools 

• Familiarity with the needs and challenges of college housing is a significant advantage 

Preferred Qualifications  

• A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate, or a related field   

• Previous experience in real estate, property management, or a related field 

• Experience in a fast-paced, growing company  

 Reasons to join our Team:  

• Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years  

• Full benefits including health care, paid time off, life insurance, and 401k plan with company match for eligible team members.  

• A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities  

• Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.  

• Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.  

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!    

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.  

Notice to external Recruiters and Recruitment Agencies:  

StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future. 
US - Salary Range
$70,000—$70,000 USD

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Partner Manager
description:
About Threecolts
Threecolts is the leading software suite for online & offline consumer brands (Amazon, Walmart, Target, Shopify, eBay, etc.). We’ve built a powerful ecosystem of software solutions to help businesses grow smarter — from revenue recovery and retail finance, to multichannel operations and pricing optimization. With over 500 employees globally and strong backing, we’re scaling fast across new markets and new partner channels.

Who We Are 
We’re a global team built for speed, trust, and impact. As an AI enabled company, AI is integrated across Threecolts from development through to operations, empowering teams to move faster, build better, improve quality, and make more informed decisions. We hire exceptional people from all backgrounds and give them the autonomy to move fast and the accountability to deliver, where you will wear multiple hats, take ownership of challenges, and proactively solve problems beyond your immediate scope. Change is constant, ambiguity is part of the deal, and clear, concise communication is how we stay aligned, so when in doubt, bring people in.

Role purpose :
The Partner Manager is responsible for building and growing a commercially significant portfolio of agency and carrier partners.

The role combines new partner acquisition with the commercial management of an existing portfolio. You will identify and secure new strategic partners, activate them quickly and develop existing relationships into consistent sources of qualified pipeline and revenue.

This is a target-driven commercial role with direct accountability for partner-sourced pipeline, annual contract value and overall channel contribution.

You will work with agencies, carriers and other ecosystem partners operating across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, TikTok Shop and adjacent retail and ecommerce platforms. Success requires the ability to build strong relationships while remaining commercially disciplined, challenging partners on performance and focusing investment on the relationships most likely to generate meaningful returns.

Scope of the role :
The Partner Manager:

• Owns a defined portfolio of revenue-generating agency and carrier partners.

• Sources and signs new partners within an assigned region or ecosystem.

• Carries individual targets for partner-sourced pipeline, ACV and channel revenue contribution.

• Owns the commercial performance, engagement and growth of their partner portfolio.

• Develops regional partner strategies based on market opportunity, partner capability and revenue potential.

• Operates with a high level of independence when deciding which partners to pursue, develop or deprioritise.

• Represents Threecolts at partner meetings, industry events, conferences and other in-person commercial opportunities.

What you will be responsible for: 

Build and grow a high-performing partner portfolio

• Own the commercial strategy and performance of a defined portfolio of agency and carrier partners.

• Develop detailed account plans for priority partners, including revenue targets, pipeline expectations, target customer segments, joint activity and quarterly growth milestones.

• Build relationships across multiple levels within agency partner organisations

• Identify opportunities to expand existing partnerships into new products, markets, customer segments or commercial models.

• Create a consistent flow of qualified referrals and co-selling opportunities rather than relying on ad hoc introductions.

• Set clear expectations with partners and hold them accountable for agreed commitments, activity and commercial outcomes.

• Review partner performance regularly and intervene where engagement, opportunity quality or revenue contribution falls below expectations.

• Protect against portfolio concentration by building a diverse mix of productive agencies, carriers and ecosystem partners.

Source and secure new partners

• Identify high-potential agencies, carriers and strategic ecosystem partners that align with Threecolts’ ideal customer profile and growth priorities.

• Build and manage a structured prospecting pipeline of potential partners across the assigned region.

• Conduct targeted outbound activity, attend relevant industry events and use existing networks to create new partnership opportunities.

• Lead the full commercial lifecycle, from initial outreach and qualification through negotiation, agreement and launch.

• Assess potential partners based on customer reach, market influence, commercial capability, strategic fit and likely revenue contribution.

• Build a clear business case for each priority partnership, including the expected opportunity, investment required and route to revenue.

• Negotiate commercial terms that create mutual value while protecting Threecolts’ economics and strategic interests.

• Maintain momentum throughout the partnership process and avoid agreements that remain inactive after signing.

Activate partners and accelerate time to revenue

• Take ownership of the period between signing a partner and generating the first qualified opportunity.

• Create structured activation plans with clear milestones, responsibilities and timelines for both Threecolts and the partner.

• Coordinate product training, commercial enablement, messaging, referral processes and launch activity.

• Agree a defined activation window for each new partner and track progress toward the first qualified opportunity and first closed revenue.

• Identify and resolve blockers that prevent a partner from introducing or co-selling Threecolts effectively.

• Maintain close engagement during the early stages of the relationship, then transition productive partners into a scalable account-management rhythm.

Performance management and reporting
The Partner Manager owns the accuracy and quality of partner performance data across their portfolio.

You will maintain an up-to-date view of:

• Partner-sourced qualified opportunities.

• Partner-sourced pipeline value.

• ACV and revenue from partner-referred deals.

• Conversion rates by partner, partner type and ecosystem.

• Conversion performance compared with non-partner channels.

• Time from partner signing to first qualified opportunity.

• Time from activation to first closed revenue.

• Opportunity quality and average deal value.

• Partner engagement, activity and retention.

• Revenue concentration across the portfolio.

• Performance against individual quarterly and annual targets.

You will use this data to identify underperforming partners, diagnose the cause and implement corrective action.

This may include changing the account plan, increasing enablement, targeting different customer segments, adjusting joint activity or deprioritising the relationship altogether.

 What success looks like
Within this role, success means:

• A predictable monthly flow of qualified partner-sourced opportunities.

• Clear pipeline, ACV and revenue contribution attributable to named partners.

• New partners progressing from signed agreement to first opportunity and first revenue within agreed timelines.

• Existing partners increasing their commercial contribution quarter over quarter.

• Strong relationships with priority partners across both operational and senior levels.

• Higher conversion rates from partner referrals due to better targeting, qualification and enablement.

• A balanced portfolio with limited dependency on one partner, ecosystem or customer segment.

• Clear decisions being made about where to invest, where to intervene and where to walk away.

• Reliable partner data that supports forecasting and commercial planning.

• Internal teams viewing Partnerships as a repeatable and dependable revenue channel, rather than opportunistic upside.

Experience and capabilities
The successful candidate is likely to bring:

• Experience in partnerships, account management, channel sales, business development, or a comparable commercial role.

• A track record of sourcing and closing new partners or strategic accounts.

• Experience growing an existing portfolio against revenue, pipeline or sales targets.

• Strong commercial negotiation and account-planning capability.

• Confidence working with senior stakeholders internally and externally.

• Experience managing multiple relationships and commercial opportunities simultaneously.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to make decisions using pipeline, conversion and revenue data.

• The ability to operate independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.

• Experience within ecommerce, SaaS, Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, retail technology, logistics or carrier ecosystems would be beneficial.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly for partner meetings, industry events and commercial opportunities.

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

• Salary:  $100,000 base salary, $200,000 OTE

• Healthcare coverage

• Pension and paid time off, including sick leave

• Fully remote/hybrid working

Note : - Regular travel is required
